drhp.business: Founded in 1980, Galaxy Surfactants makes performance surfactants — the core of cleansing and foaming applications — and specialty ingredients engineered to deliver targeted, high-value functionalities in formulations for the home and personal care industry. It supplies over 215 products to more than 1,500 customers across 95+ countries, with manufacturing facilities located in India, Egypt and the United States. The Company also runs a dedicated D2C vertical that co-creates formulations with emerging beauty and personal care brands, from concept-to-prototype through to commercialisation …

risks.note: Escalation of conflicts in the Middle East and Red Sea can disrupt global supply chains and trade routes, while the trade tariff war between major economies such as the US and China creates uncertainty and could lead to increased costs and supply chain disruptions.
risks.risk: Global geopolitical conflict and trade/tariff disruption

risks.note: Unavailability or constrained availability of key feedstocks/critical raw materials, or slower-than-expected demand recovery, may bear on volumes and adversely impact FY2027 performance.

Fatty Alcohol and Fatty Acids account for the majority of raw material purchases and are sourced from South East Asia; these markets stayed structurally tight and elevated on feedstock constraints, capacity dynamics and geopolitical disruption, while petrochemical feedstocks saw sharp cost pressure late in the year on elevated crude prices.
risks.risk: Raw-material price volatility in fatty alcohol and petrochemical inputs

risks.note: Although the destocking cycle has ended, delay in new launches or a slower-than-expected restocking/recovery cycle in Premium specialties will adversely impact profitability going ahead.
risks.risk: Gestation risk on new launches and premium specialty restocking

risks.note: Container unavailability, a sudden increase in freight costs, or increased lead times from sudden route changes as seen during the Red Sea crisis pose risk to volumes and overall profitability.
risks.risk: Logistics — container availability, freight cost and lead times

risks.note: Delayed or below-average monsoons in India may halt growth momentum since rural recovery is a critical requisite for Indian demand; climatic catastrophes pose an unquantifiable risk to global supply chains and adversely impact consumption.
risks.risk: Climate risk and monsoon dependence of Indian demand

risks.note: A BRSR-identified material issue: risk of process safety incidents and occupational health hazards, mitigated through ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 implementation, Process Safety Management, Behaviour-Based Safety programmes, regular audits, training and Board oversight.
risks.risk: Employee safety, health and process-safety incidents

risks.note: A BRSR-identified material issue: risk from water scarcity and climate variability, mitigated through Zero Liquid Discharge facilities, rainwater harvesting, recycling, water-usage monitoring, ISO 46001:2019 implementation and community water projects.
